note: Four behavioral axes. Every answer option and every dinosaur is a point in this same 4D box, which is what makes Euclidean matching meaningful.

traits.name: Dietary Strategy
traits.question: Do you go and take what you want, or gather what you need?

traits.name: Social Mechanics
traits.question: Do you operate alone, or as part of something bigger?

traits.name: Environmental Strategy
traits.question: Do you move fast and stay light, or dig in and hold?

traits.name: Cognitive Approach
traits.question: Do you think your way through, or push your way through?
